sources.title: List of federally regulated industries and workplaces
sources.scope: Federal jurisdiction sector and workplace routing; directs non-federal workplaces to province or territory.
sources.notes: Use as scope routing, not as a determination for an individual employer.

sources.title: Occupational health and safety in federally regulated workplaces
sources.scope: Canada Labour Code Part II workplace duties and federal-only application.
sources.notes: Use with the current Code and regulations for a legal conclusion.

sources.title: WHMIS 2015 supplier requirements
sources.scope: Federal supplier obligations under the Hazardous Products Act and Hazardous Products Regulations.
sources.notes: Supplier guidance does not decide the employer's provincial or federal workplace regime.

sources.title: Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA)
sources.scope: Ontario workplace OH&S framework and regulations; federal workplaces remain separately routed.
sources.notes: Use e-Laws for the current Act and applicable regulation text.

sources.title: Occupational Health and Safety Regulation
sources.scope: Workplaces under WorkSafeBC inspectional jurisdiction; excludes mines and federally chartered workplaces as described by the source.
sources.notes: Check the searchable regulation and updates for the activity date.

sources.title: Occupational Health and Safety Code
sources.scope: Alberta OHS Act, Regulation, and Code framework; the page identifies the Code in force March 31, 2025 and later amendments.
sources.notes: Confirm the in-force version and amendments for the activity date.

sources.title: Act respecting occupational health and safety
sources.scope: Quebec occupational health and safety Act and official consolidation.
sources.notes: Preserve official-language source identity and consult applicable regulations.

sources.title: NAICS Canada 2022, sector 31-33 manufacturing
sources.scope: Manufacturing activity definition and classification context; not a workplace-law jurisdiction test.
sources.notes: Use for activity classification only; do not infer regulatory status from NAICS alone.
